metadata.title: Noir Interior Portrait with Red Accents

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white interior portrait featuring a seated subject against a void-like dark background, accented by bold red sans-serif typography in the upper corner.
triggerTerms: stark b&w photography with red text
minimalist room with radiator and framed photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic scene divided by sharp architectural lines, featuring a woman in a dark suit seated in a chair. The left side is dominated by a deep black void behind the subject, while the right side is a bright, high-key white room containing a vintage radiator and a small framed photograph. Bold red text is anchored in the top-left dark space.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned in the lower-left quadrant against a dark void
Vertical architectural line bisecting the frame into light and dark zones
Repetitive vertical lines of the radiator echoing the room's verticality
Small framed photo in the upper right balancing the heavy text in the upper left
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white palette for the image
Vibrant red as the sole color for typography
Deep, detail-less black shadows contrasting with blown-out white walls

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated, medium-full shot, occupying the lower-left third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold red text in the top-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red text, moves down to the subject, then follows the floor line to the radiator on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the black void behind the subject and the white wall on the right.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vivid red for all typographic elements
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero saturation in the image and high saturation in the text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars are added as underlines or dividers between lines of text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in varying scales or with graphic dividers.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule/underline integrated with the text block

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the original.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean grotesque terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a woman in a dark suit sitting on a chair. The left background is a pitch-black void; the right background is a bright white room with a vintage radiator and a small framed photo on the wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed red sans-serif text in the top-left corner. Use all caps and include a thin red horizontal line between the two lines of text.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the text the only source of color (red)?
Is the composition split between a dark void and a bright room?
Is the font a bold, condensed sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific room details (e.g., type of radiator)
mustRedesign: Avoid literal recreation of the specific person's face
Do not use the specific framed photo content
Ensure the red text is a generic placeholder

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean edges between light and dark

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black and pure white levels
Ensure no other colors besides red are present
Confirm the subject is seated and facing the camera
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W photography + Seated subject + Architectural split + Bold red condensed sans-serif overlay.
